To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed a new method for multi-oriented video text detection which is based on the observation of symmetry in text and the nearest neighbor concept.

the proposed method is able to detect multi-oriented text in video frames and the proposed method out-performs other existing methods for video text detection and the state of art methods for scene (still image) text detection.

we have proposed a novel method that combines wavelet and median moments with k-means to identify text in a video frame and then a new method called APBG for multi-oriented text detection in the video frame which outperforms existing approaches for video and the existing methods for scene text.
In summary, our research is concerned with
two issues: 1. How to classify a video frame as text or non-text?

the following: 1) A new text frame classification approach based on wavelet transform, median-moments and k-means clustering; 2) A new text detection method in video frames based on symmetry, Sobel edge map and APBG; and 3) A new multi-oriented text detection approach based on symmetry, edge map, APBG and directional information.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed method is the most accurate and reliable method for video text recognition.
the proposed method is the best performing method for scene text in video and also the best performing method on the ICDAR-2003 competition dataset.
this paper presents a robust method that is able to detect text in a wide variety of video frames and is able to deal with multi-orientations of text in the video frames.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a new method for text detection in video which outperforms existing state of the art video text detection methods and the state of art scene text detection methods.
the proposed method can detect multi-oriented text lines from video frames in a robust manner.
the method is able to detect multi-oriented scene text in a video frame and is robust to various challenges such as illumination, blur, shadow, and noise.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we propose a method for video text which is not limited to horizontal text.
the proposed method is robust, efficient, and accurate.
we propose a novel combination of features for video text frame classification and multi-oriented text detection in the frame.
